entities.summary: Skantzoura is an island in the Sporades archipelago, along the east coast of Greece. The island is located 18 km (11 mi) southeast of the larger island of Alonnisos and 31 km (19 mi) northwest of the island of Skyros. As of 2011, it had no resident population. Skantzoura is in Zone B of the Alonnisos Marine Park.
